# okstatus_incident (Resource)

An OKStatus incident tied to a monitor. Unlike most resources, `status`/`message` don't get PATCHed as plain fields — api-v1 appends a timeline update each time `status` changes, so `message` is required whenever `status` is changed.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "okstatus_monitor" "api" {
  name = "Production API"
  url  = "https://api.example.com/health"
  type = "http"
}

resource "okstatus_incident" "example" {
  title      = "Elevated API latency"
  severity   = "minor"
  monitor_id = okstatus_monitor.api.id
  status     = "investigating"
  message    = "Investigating a latency spike on the API monitor."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `message` (String) Timeline message posted alongside the current `status`.
- `monitor_id` (String)
- `status` (String) One of `investigating`, `identified`, `monitoring`, `resolved`.
- `title` (String)

### Optional

- `severity` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
